# Day on Torts

> A comprehensive Tennessee personal injury and tort law resource featuring case analyses, legal insights, and reference materials for civil litigation practitioners.

Day on Torts is published by John Day of The Law Offices of John Day, P.C., and serves as a leading resource for Tennessee tort law. The site provides detailed case analyses, legal commentary, and access to the Day on Torts: Leading Cases in Tennessee Tort Law subscription service, covering critical areas including legal malpractice, malicious prosecution, wrongful death, and expert testimony requirements.

## Key Topics

- Tennessee tort law
- Legal malpractice
- Expert testimony
- Case analysis
- Summary judgment
- Malicious prosecution
- Wrongful death
- Attorney liability
- Tennessee Court of Appeals
- Tennessee Supreme Court
- Contract law
- Criminal law
- Tennessee rules of civil procedure
- Favorable termination
- Nolle prosequi

## Core Resources

- [Day on Torts Homepage](https://www.dayontorts.com): Main hub for Day on Torts, Tennessee personal injury law resource by John Day
- [Day on Torts Book](https://www.dayontorts.com/day-on-torts-book): Day on Torts: Leading Cases in Tennessee Tort Law subscription service and comprehensive reference
- [Topics Directory](https://www.dayontorts.com/topics): Directory of tort law topics and legal resource categories for civil litigation

## Legal Malpractice Case Analyses

- [TPPA did not apply to legal malpractice claim](https://www.dayontorts.com/tppa-did-not-apply-to-legal-malpractice-claim.html): Case analysis of Cartwright v. Hendrix on TPPA and legal malpractice
- [Legal Malpractice Falls Short - No Causation Demonstrated](https://www.dayontorts.com/legal-malpractice-falls-short-no-causation-demonstrated.html): Case analysis of Buhler v. Lefkovitz on legal malpractice causation requirement
- [Legal malpractice claim time-barred](https://www.dayontorts.com/legal-malpractice-claim-time-barred-2.html): Case analysis of LaChappelle v. Tual on legal malpractice statute of limitations
- [Tennessee legal malpractice claim required expert proof of standard of care](https://www.dayontorts.com/tennessee-legal-malpractice-claim-required-expert-proof-of-standard-of-care.html): Analysis of Mamadou v. Gatti on expert proof requirement in legal malpractice

## Tort Law Case Analyses

- [Nolle prosequi dismissal was not a favorable termination for malicious prosecution claim](https://www.dayontorts.com/nolle-prosequi-dismissal-was-not-a-favorable-termination-for-malicious-prosecution-claim.html): Case analysis of Smith v. Dillard on malicious prosecution and nolle prosequi
- [Evidence of Re-Marriage Admissible in Wrongful Death Case; Errata Sheet Could Be Used in Cross-Examination](https://www.dayontorts.com/evidence-of-re-marriage-admissible-in-wrongful-death-case-errata-sheet-could-be-used-in-cross-examination.html): Analysis of Davis v. Ellis on evidence admissibility in wrongful death HCLA case
- [School's duty to supervise student affirmed](https://www.dayontorts.com/schools-duty-to-supervise-student-affirmed.html): Analysis of Dodson-Stephens case on school supervision duty and negligence
- [Damages based on fraud not limited by contractual language](https://www.dayontorts.com/damages-based-on-fraud-not-limited-by-contractual-language.html): Analysis of fraud damages not limited by contract language in auction dispute

## Expert Testimony & Evidence

- [Plaintiff needed expert testimony to support claim that mold in vehicle caused personal injury](https://www.dayontorts.com/plaintiff-needed-expert-testimony-to-support-claim-that-mold-in-vehicle-caused-personal-injury.html): Analysis of Mullis v. SAI Chattanooga on expert testimony for mold injury claims
